name: Mathematical Isomorphism via Function Averages
description: Transforms the 2-stage scheduling and sum/max bottleneck conditions into evaluating the average value (integral) and endpoint values of a set of linear functions f(x) = p1*x + p2*(1-x) over the interval [0,1]. This completely removes the affordances of "phase 1 + phase 2" and "total load of phase", forcing models to do algebraic deduction to realize they just need to check p1+p2 > T and sum(p1) > T.
